behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert exact/subtree exclusions versus sibling prefix, deduplication/order and invalid-path no-IO.
Assert serial selected-only stat/read calls, directory skips, hashes and exact first-error stop.
docDelivery: Document relative-path domain, validation, sorting and exclusion boundaries.
Explain injected/default fs, lazy selected-file reads and first-error behavior.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Pure relative-path selection with segment exclusions and ordered injected filesystem adapter; hashing visible bytes only.
manualBehavior: Selection is pure and shared; filesystem adapter does not duplicate filter policy or pre-read excluded entries.
independence: Separate manifest path filtering from filesystem adapter preserving ordering, excluded paths and no unnecessary reads.
